UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 4 – RAGHAV JHUNJHUNWALA appeared for a detailed UPSC Personality Test 
1:1 Session With Sriram Sir.

In this session, the panel evaluates the candidate on personality, analytical thinking, current affairs awareness, and decision-making ability — the key qualities expected from a future civil servant.

This mock interview reflects the type of questions asked in the UPSC Civil Services Personality Test conducted by the UPSC Board.

Watch this interview to understand:
How UPSC interview questions are framed
How toppers structure their answers
How to handle pressure during the IAS interview
Personality traits UPSC board looks for
Strategy for UPSC CSE personality test

This video is extremely helpful for UPSC aspirants preparing for the UPSC Interview and Civil Services Examination.

Candidate: ANUJ AGNIHOTRI 
UPSC CSE 2025 Rank: AIR 1

Stay tuned for more UPSC topper interviews, preparation strategies, and civil services guidance.
